summary: The FileManagement class handles the process of saving uploaded files to a server, ensuring data privacy through anonymization and validating file types and sizes.
purpose: The purpose of the FileManagement class is to securely handle file uploads, manage file storage within unique folders, anonymize file names when necessary, and enforce file size and type restrictions.

fields.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
fields.description: The maximum allowed file size for uploads, set to 50 MB.

fields.name: FileName
fields.description: The path and name of the final saved file.

fields.name: FileURL
fields.description: The URL path to access the uploaded file.

fields.name: FileSize
fields.description: The size of the uploaded file in bytes.

fields.name: FileType
fields.description: The type of the uploaded file, converted to a user-friendly format.

fields.name: imgBinaryData
fields.description: Binary data of the image if the uploaded file is an image.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.description: Session object used to manage and track session-specific information.

actors.name: FileUpload
actors.description: Object representing the file that has been uploaded.

workflows.name: Handle Uploaded File
steps: Check if the uploaded file is not null and has content.
Validate if the uploaded file size is within the allowed maximum file size.
If an image is uploaded, validate it is not in 32bppCMYK format.
Generate a new file name, optionally anonymizing it.
Create a unique folder to store the file using a GUID.
Save the uploaded file to the created folder.
Update session messages with errors if any validation fails.

business_rules.description: Uploaded files must not exceed 50 MB.
Image files must not be in 32bppCMYK format.

calculations.description: Convert file size from bytes to MB for readability.

conditions.name: File Exists and Has Content
conditions.description: Check that the uploaded file is not null and has content length greater than zero.

system_behavior: Saves files to a unique directory generated by a GUID.
Anonymizes file names if specified by appending a timestamp.
dependencies: System.Web for handling web context and file uploads.

exceptions.description: Throws error if file size exceeds the limit.
Throws error if file type is an unsupported JPEG format.
